name: average_order_value
question: what is the average order value?
reference_sql: SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.qty * oi.price) AS total
JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
reading: The mean of the order totals, not the mean of the line totals. Averaging order_item directly answers a different question and is the common way to get this wrong.
